title: Ruth Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Ruth 2: Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz and finds favor with him.

questions.text: How is Boaz described at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Naomi had a relative of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, named Boaz.

answers.text: A priest who served in Bethlehem
A mighty man of wealth of Elimelech's family
A Moabite merchant who traded grain
A poor reaper who worked for hire

questions.text: How did Boaz greet the reapers when he came from Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: Boaz said to the reapers, "May Yahweh be with you."

questions.text: To whom did Boaz ask, "Whose young lady is this?"
questions.explanation: Boaz asked his servant who was set over the reapers, "Whose young lady is this?"

questions.text: Where did Boaz tell Ruth to drink when she was thirsty?
questions.explanation: He said, "When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn."

answers.text: From the well at the city gate
From the vessels the young men had filled
At Naomi's house in the city

questions.text: What had Boaz been told about Ruth?
questions.explanation: He had been told all she had done for her mother-in-law since her husband's death, and how she had left her parents and her land.

answers.text: That she owned land in Moab
That she had a brother in Bethlehem
What she had done for her mother-in-law

questions.text: Under whose wings had Ruth come to take refuge, according to Boaz?
questions.explanation: Boaz said she had come to take refuge under the wings of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

questions.text: At mealtime, what did Boaz invite Ruth to dip her bread in?
questions.explanation: Boaz said, "Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar."

questions.text: How much barley did Ruth have after beating out what she gleaned?
questions.explanation: She gleaned until evening, beat out what she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.

questions.text: What did Naomi tell Ruth about Boaz?
questions.explanation: Naomi said, "The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen."

questions.text: Until when did Ruth stay close to the maidens of Boaz to glean?
questions.explanation: She stayed close to the maidens of Boaz to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest.

answers.text: The start of the grape harvest in autumn
The first cold days of the winter
Just one week, then she stopped
The end of barley harvest and wheat harvest
